# Pull request

## Summary and motivation

What problem does this solve? List the changes and related issues (administrative work may omit an issue).

## Traceability and decision status

Relevant Mxx, ACxx, DEC-xxx and PRE-xx references, or explain why not applicable. Identify accepted decisions separately from recommendations. Does this require approval or affect baseline blockers?

## Evidence and verification

Commands actually run and results. Documentation-only work may report repository checks; do not invent application tests. For research include dated source links, versions, evidence type, confidence, limitations and implications for open decisions. Distinguish source review from live validation.

## Risks, limitations and outstanding questions

Include dependency additions, security/architecture implications and unverified outcomes.

## Breaking changes

Describe migration/impact, or state none.

## Reviewer checklist

- [ ] Scope is focused and the complete diff has been self-reviewed.
- [ ] Requirements and approval statuses remain accurate.
- [ ] Checks/tests and documentation are appropriate to the change.
- [ ] No secrets, unsupported compatibility claims or unexplained dependencies.
- [ ] Architecture boundaries and discovery restrictions are respected.
